CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Srijit Choudhary, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shailesh Kr. Sinha, Addl.P.P

For the Informant : Mr. Shailendra Jit, Advocate ------
Order No.03 Dated- 08-05-2025 I.A. No.5638 of 2025 Heard the parties.
This interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer for early hearing of the instant bail application.
Since, the hearing of instant bail application is taken up, hence, this interlocutory application stands disposed of being infructuous.
This interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to grant bail to the petitioner as the marriage of the brother of the petitioner is scheduled to take place on 15th May, 2025.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Bishnugarh P.S. Case No.84 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. Cas No.2087 of 2024 registered under Section 341, 323, 376, 302, 120B, 504,
506 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the Saurabh Kumar @ Saurabh Kumar Rawani vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65261698/
1 petitioner has committed rape upon the prosecutrix repeatedly and also harassed her husband by stating vulgar things about the prosecutrix due to which the husband of the prosecutrix committed suicide.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the allegation against the petitioner is false and there is inordinate delay in lodging the FIR.

It is lastly submitted that since the marriage of the brother of the petitioner is scheduled to take place on 15th May, 2025, hence it is submitted that the petitioner be released on provisional bail.
Learned Addl. P.P. and the learned counsel for the informant have not raised any serious objection.

Considering the fact that the marriage of the brother of the petitioner is scheduled to take place on 15th May, 2025, the above-named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail provisionally on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand) on 12.05.2025 with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Hazaribagh in connection with Bishnugarh P.S. Case No.84 of 2024 corresponding to G.R. Cas No.2087 of 2024 till 19.05.2025, with a direction that he must surrender before the learned trial court by 19.05.2025 and file an affidavit within one week from 19.05.2025 in this case, in this court, that he has surrendered before the learned trial court, with the copy of the order- sheet.

(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Animesh/
